info.title: Epoch API
info.summary: Public v1 API: research, saved-study execution, answers, files, datasets, Space and webhooks.
info.description: Accepted for implementation (ENG-2504); not served until ENG-2512 mounts it. One host per environment serves only /v1/* and /.well-known/*. The service runs the Epoch SDK core server-side; callers never use the LangGraph protocol. Each operation's x-epoch-reuses names the SDK method and native routes it reuses, and any gap that needs new work. Generated from agent_src/public_api; do not edit by hand.

post.description: POSTed to your endpoint. Verify Epoch-Signature before trusting the body: HMAC-SHA256 with the endpoint secret over '<t>.<raw body>', compared with v1 in constant time; reject timestamps older than 5 minutes. Delivery is at least once; drop duplicates by event id. Answer 2xx within 10 seconds; anything else is retried with backoff, and repeated failures disable the endpoint.

NativeUIMessage.title: NativeUIMessage
NativeUIMessage.description:
Source envelope: langgraph.graph.ui.UIMessage.

Component names/props and metadata extensions are deliberately service-owned
extension points, as in Portal's UIMessage registry. They remain JSON here;
SDK session events themselves have closed, validated outer shapes.

TokenRequest.title: TokenRequest
TokenRequest.description:
OAuth token request: RFC 8693 exchange of an unexpired Cognito ID token from browser sign-in.

There are no Epoch refresh tokens. A signed-in SDK refreshes its Cognito session and exchanges
the new ID token again; signing out revokes the Cognito session.

url.description: HTTPS only; private, loopback and link-local addresses are refused.
